description: Reduced copy of the Anis Partner API error catalogue: the public codes only, with their HTTP status, whether they are retryable and the retry guidance. Every code is documented at https://developers.anis.ly.

representations.retryGuidance: Correct the signing credentials or profile before retrying; key and application state details are intentionally indistinguishable.
Reserved: the current API never sends this code. A signature outside its validity window is answered invalid_credentials (401); sign again with current timestamps.
Reserved: the current API never sends this code. A Content-Digest that does not match the body is answered malformed_signed_request (400).

Rebuild how the request is signed: send both Signature and Signature-Input, cover the required components in the documented order, send every header the route requires, and compute Content-Digest over the exact body bytes. Repeating the same request unchanged fails the same way.
Use a fresh nonce and signature while preserving the idempotency key for the same business intent.
Anis network protection blocked this source address. Contact Anis support with the address if it should be allowed.
The application is not permitted to make this call: check that it holds the permission the call needs and that you call from a network agreed with Anis, then ask Anis staff to change either.
Restore the directly owned active account and Business subscription before making a new request.
Verify the resource identifier and application ownership; inaccessible resources are intentionally indistinguishable from absence.
Verify the sold-card identifier and wallet; absent and inaccessible single cards return the same representation.
Obtain an approved current wallet grant before making a new request.

The response never names the field: check the request against the documented rules before sending it again. How the request is sent counts too: a body over 64 KB, a chunked body (send Content-Length instead), headers over 32 KB in total, a path and query over 2,048 characters, a body on a call that takes none, or an order whose Idempotency-Key is missing or is not a UUID written with hyphens.
Reuse the key only for identical intent; use a new UUID only for a genuinely new operation.
Not an error: the order was accepted and is still being processed. Wait for the Retry-After delay, then repeat the identical POST with the same Idempotency-Key.
Submit a new operation with explicit allowed-debt consent if the Partner intends to use debt.
Submit a new operation only after the authoritative balance or allowed-debt state changes.
The owner policy forbids this purchase; obtain authorization before submitting a new operation.
The request conflicts with current owner business state; submit a new operation only after that state changes.
Do not poll; submit a new operation and idempotency key only after the owner allowance is known to have changed.
No reset time is available; submit a new operation and idempotency key only after the limit condition is known to have cleared.
honour Retry-After when present; otherwise use bounded exponential backoff.
Submit a new request only after the wallet has been re-enabled.
Submit a new request only after the account or Business subscription expiry is resolved.
Restore an active Business subscription before making a new request.
Confirm or re-enable the owner account before making a new request.
Use the currency required by the authoritative wallet and Catalogue contract.
Refresh Catalogue data and submit a new operation if the item becomes available.
Refresh Catalogue data or submit a new operation with an available quantity.
Refresh the current price and explicitly accept it in a new operation.
The card-level reveal predicate refused disclosure; do not retry until the card state is known to have changed.
Use individual reveal for selected cards; invoice reveal is capped at 100.
Obtain a new enrollment invitation through the approved staff process.
Restart enrollment through the approved staff action and use the new challenge generation.
Correct the P-256/P1363 proof for the active challenge generation.
This invitation already took a key, so a newly generated key pair is refused too. Read the enrolment status first; to enrol a different key, ask Anis staff to restart the enrolment.
Retry with the same idempotency key for the same mutation intent after bounded backoff.
Inspect operation status or repeat the identical request with the same idempotency key.
Preserve the same accepted operation and idempotency key; retry only after bounded backoff or platform remediation.
